baseUrl.description: URL of the local server; {port} is replaced with a free port. For loopback hosts the other loopback addresses are tried too

startCommand.description: Starts the app; {port} is replaced and PORT is set

cwd.description: Directory (relative to this file) where commands run

files.description: Globs (relative to the config file) whose changes affect this route

actions.description: Steps to run before the static screenshot

focus.description: Added to the top-level focus for this route

ignore.description: Added to the top-level ignore for this route

globalFiles.description: Globs whose changes affect every route

focus.description: CSS selectors of the only areas to compare (pixels and styles); the rest of the page is not diffed

ignore.description: CSS selectors of areas not to compare: painted over in the screenshots and left out of the style diff

uiPackages.description: Package names (* wildcards) whose version changes may change the UI; replaces the default list, so keep the entries you still want

dependencyRoutes.description: Routes captured when a UI package changes; default: every known route

query.description: Query params added to every URL, e.g. { "theme": "dark" }

localStorage.description: localStorage entries set before the page loads

channel.description: Installed browser to capture with instead of Playwright's Chromium, e.g. "chrome" (UI_DIFF_BROWSER_CHANNEL overrides it)

disableAnimations.description: Older switch: false turns off freeze.animations

waitForFonts.description: Older switch: false turns off freeze.fonts

fixedTime.description: Older form of freeze.time: an ISO timestamp or "run-start" sets it; false leaves freeze.time in charge

stableRandom.description: Older switch: false turns off freeze.random

scrollToLoad.description: Scroll through the page first to trigger lazy content, then back to the top

stableShots.description: Retake until this many consecutive screenshots match

styleMaxElements.description: Most visible elements whose computed styles are recorded per capture (token audit); a warning says when a page has more

freeze.description: Inputs frozen before every still capture, the same on both sides

clock.description: Freeze Date at `time` with the Playwright clock on both sides (timers keep running), so clocks and "2 min ago" match

time.description: "run-start" (the same instant on both sides) or an ISO timestamp

animations.description: Finish CSS animations and transitions, hide the caret and set prefers-reduced-motion for still captures

fonts.description: Wait until no web font is loading (document.fonts) before capturing

enabled.description: Record the element map of every capture and describe changes as measured style changes

maxChanges.description: Most element changes kept per capture in report.json

minConfidence.description: Changes of elements matched with less confidence are listed as unverified

states.description: Hover and focus states of links, buttons, form fields and other interactive elements

enabled.description: Capture interactive elements in their hover and keyboard focus states on both sides and compare them

hover.description: Hover each element with the real pointer

focus.description: Reach each element with the Tab key, so :focus-visible applies

maxElements.description: Interactive elements checked per page, in document order; the rest are counted as skipped

padding.description: CSS px around an element in its state crops, so focus rings and shadows show

flows.description: Interactions replayed on both sides (open a menu, fill a form); the page is captured and diffed at each checkpoint

checkpoint.description: Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"
Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"
Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"
Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"

anyOf.description: Replaces the field value with text

checkpoint.description: Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"

anyOf.description: A key on the focused element, e.g. "Escape" or "Enter"

checkpoint.description: Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"

anyOf.description: Picks the option with this value or label

checkpoint.description: Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"

anyOf.description: To a y position in px, or until an element is in view

checkpoint.description: Capture the page after this step under this name, e.g. "after open"

anyOf.description: Milliseconds, or until an element is visible

viewports.description: Default: the viewports of the route

themes.description: Default: the themes of the route

maxFlows.description: Flows run per run, in config order; the rest are listed as not run

maxSteps.description: Longest flow that runs; a longer one is listed as not run

stepTimeoutMs.description: How long a step waits for its element before the flow stops there

components.description: Single components diffed on their own: a tight crop and only the measured changes inside them

route.description: Path the component is on; or give flow

flow.description: Name of a flow whose checkpoint shows the component

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint of that flow; default: its last one

selector.description: CSS selector of the component root; it must match exactly one element

states.description: Default: ["default"]; "hover" puts the pointer on the root, "focus" reaches the root (or its first focusable element) with the keyboard

viewports.description: Default: the viewports of the route or flow

themes.description: Default: the themes of the route or flow

maxComponents.description: Components run per run, in config order; the rest are listed as not run

padding.description: CSS px around the component in its crop

dataLabel.description: What test data the app ran with (a fixture name, seed or dataset version), shown in the capture settings; "not declared" when unset

alignShifts.description: Match content that only moved up or down (e.g. below a taller hero) and report it as shifted instead of changed

preview.description: Use already-deployed preview URLs instead of local worktrees

auth.description: Credentials for protected previews, read from environment variables

origins.description: Origins that may receive the credentials; default: the preview URL origins

all.description: Record clips for routes without visual changes too (same as --motion-all)

parallel.description: Record base and head at the same time (each in its own page); false records them one after the other

categories.description: Map token names to categories when their names do not say it, e.g. { "spacing": ["--s-*"], "font-size": ["--fs-*"] }

maxElements.description: Deprecated: use capture.styleMaxElements (still honoured when that is not set)

linkBase.description: Override the image URL prefix (e.g. for GitHub Enterprise)

title: ui-diff configuration
description: Configuration for the ui-diff skill (before/after screenshots and pixel diffs for pull requests).
